Title: Backend skeleton: Spring Boot project, DB schema, entities
User Story: As a developer, I want the backend and database set up so features can be built on it.
Acceptance Criteria: App boots; tables for users, change_requests, approvals, audit_log exist.

Title: Frontend skeleton: React app, routing, layout
User Story: As a developer, I want the React app and routes in place so screens can be added.
Acceptance Criteria: Routes for login, dashboard, CR form and CR list render.

Title: GitHub Actions: build and test on every PR
User Story: As a team, we want automated checks on every pull request.
Acceptance Criteria: A PR triggers build and tests; status shows on the PR.

Title: Sprint 1 demo video (1 min) uploaded to repo
User Story: As a team, we want a short video of the working Sprint 1 product.
Acceptance Criteria: Video in /demo shows login to submit to approve flow.

Title: Final documentation and Sprint 2 demo video (2 min)
User Story: As a team, we want final docs and a 2-minute demo of the finished product.
Acceptance Criteria: Docs updated, deviations noted, video uploaded to repo.

Title: User login with session timeout
User Story: As a user, I want to log in with username and password so I can access the system.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials grant access; expired session forces re-login.

Title: Role-based access control (Requester, CAB, Implementer, Admin)
User Story: As an admin, I want features restricted by role so users only do what they are allowed to.
Acceptance Criteria: Users see only actions permitted for their role.

Title: Account lockout after 5 failed logins
User Story: As an admin, I want accounts locked after repeated failures to stop guessing attacks.
Acceptance Criteria: Account locks after 5 failures and admin is notified.

Title: Submit a change request
User Story: As a requester, I want to submit a change request with title, description, category, priority and affected systems.
Acceptance Criteria: CR saved with unique ID and status Submitted.

Title: Attach supporting documents to a CR
User Story: As a requester, I want to attach documents to my CR as evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid files attach; oversized or invalid types are rejected.

Title: View status and history of own CRs
User Story: As a requester, I want to see my CRs and their status history.
Acceptance Criteria: Status timeline reflects every state change.

Title: Record risk level on a CR
User Story: As a CAB member, I want to set a risk level (Low/Medium/High) on a CR.
Acceptance Criteria: Risk level saved and visible on the CR.

Title: Require rollback plan for High-risk CRs
User Story: As a CAB member, I want High-risk CRs blocked without a rollback plan.
Acceptance Criteria: Submission rejected without rollback plan when risk is High.

Title: Approve or reject a CR with comments
User Story: As a CAB member, I want to approve or reject a CR with mandatory comments.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision and comments saved against the CR; status updates.

Title: Request more information on a CR
User Story: As a CAB member, I want to send a CR back asking for more information.
Acceptance Criteria: CR status becomes Info Requested; requester can update and resubmit.

Title: Change calendar with blackout-period conflict check
User Story: As an approver, I want to schedule approved changes on a calendar and be warned of blackout conflicts.
Acceptance Criteria: Conflicting schedule attempts are blocked or warned.

Title: Track implementation status
User Story: As an implementer, I want to update status (Scheduled, In Progress, Completed, Failed, Rolled Back).
Acceptance Criteria: Status changes saved and shown to requester.

Title: Post-implementation review notes
User Story: As an implementer, I want to record review notes after a change completes.
Acceptance Criteria: Notes saved against the CR after completion.

Title: Email notification on status change
User Story: As a requester, I want an email whenever my CR status changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Email sent on every status transition.

Title: Audit and summary reports
User Story: As an admin, I want reports on CR volume, approval turnaround and success rate.
Acceptance Criteria: Report page shows counts and averages for a chosen period.

Title: Page response time <= 3s (95th percentile)
User Story: As a user, I want pages to respond quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: 95th percentile <= 3s in load test.

Title: 99.5% monthly availability
User Story: As a user, I want the system available when I need it.
Acceptance Criteria: Health check and uptime reporting in place.

Title: Log all CR actions with timestamp and user ID
User Story: As an auditor, I want every action on a CR logged.
Acceptance Criteria: Audit log records user, action and time for each CR action.

Title: Support 50 concurrent users
User Story: As an org, we want the system to handle 50 users at once.
Acceptance Criteria: Load test with 50 users meets response targets.

Title: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility on key screens
User Story: As a user with accessibility needs, I want key screens usable.
Acceptance Criteria: Accessibility check passes on login, CR form and approval screens.

Title: TLS 1.2+ for all connections
User Story: As an org, we want all traffic encrypted.
Acceptance Criteria: Connections below TLS 1.2 are rejected.

Title: Salted password hashing
User Story: As an org, we want passwords never stored in plaintext.
Acceptance Criteria: DB shows hashed values only; nothing logged.

Title: Enforce RBAC on every API endpoint
User Story: As an org, we want role checks on the server, not only the UI.
Acceptance Criteria: Direct API call by unauthorised role returns 403.

Title: Tamper-evident audit trail
User Story: As an auditor, I want audit records that standard users cannot edit or delete.
Acceptance Criteria: Audit records immutable to non-admin roles.

Title: Session expiry and re-auth for final approval
User Story: As an org, we want idle sessions to expire and approvals to need re-authentication.
Acceptance Criteria: Session expires after 15 min; re-auth prompt on final approval.
